chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: European fans who know the discographies; Marie Bryant copying Louis
summary: A German fan quotes his first Armstrong record date back to him, and Callender recalls Marie Bryant singing "Sunny Side" note for note like Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: They know more about it than most people here do. In Germany, for instance, after a break someone comes up to me with a book and says, "Hey, your first record date was with Louis Armstrong on such-and-such a date, and there was Paul Barbarin on drums and Luis Russell played the piano, and Charlie Holmes played the alto saxophone, and Louis sang "Once In A While" and "Sunny Side of the Street." When I think of "Sunny Side of the Street"... Would you remember Marie Bryant, by any chance?
Well, she loved Louis so much until this is one of the things that she did note-for-note, exactly like Louis did it.
I could go on and on, but I have to cut this one short.
